modalities.evidence: fMRI data from a passive viewing task
Behavioral BDM auction data on 60 snack-food items

output.population: 36 healthy right-handed participants, ages 20 to 34; 27 also completed a one-month follow-up
output.summary: Healthy adults completed the cue-approach training paradigm with snack-food items. Data include auction ratings, passive viewing and probe choice fMRI, structural scans, and training behavior across sessions, plus derivatives.
